title: Integral component of higher pullback tensor composition coherence
statement:
theorem pullbackTensorIntegralCompositionCoherence {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (h : Z ⟶ X)
    [hX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [hY : ∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [hZ : ∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)] :
    ∀ M N : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y,
      canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor_composition l E f h M N

source.place: Tag 07A4, label lemma-pullback-tensor-product; component extracted from the parent composition proof.
